title: Pinaka UQS Event — local response record (v2)
description: TIER: CORE. The one record written for every answer the student gives. It is the single fuel for three things: local diagnosis (per-topic and per-misconception mastery), the spaced-repetition scheduler, and the opt-in anonymised telemetry export. Exam-agnostic by design. Written locally first; nothing leaves the device unless the student opts in. install_id is a random per-install identifier, never personal identity. This record is a one-way door: changing its shape breaks historical comparability, so it is locked early and evolved only via schema_version. v2 (ADR 0009): adds optional device_context (form factor, viewport class) and enforces response shape per item_type.

event_id.description: UUID for this response, generated locally.

install_id.description: Random per-install id. Not personal identity. Lets opt-in aggregates group a device's responses without naming the person.

item_content_hash.description: Ties the response to the exact item version answered, so calibration survives content edits.

tests.description: Skill nodes the item exercised, copied from the item at answer time.

mode.description: review = a spaced-repetition resurface; diagnostic = the onboarding placement; mock = a timed full paper; drill = ordinary practice.

selected_misconception.description: For a wrong single_best answer, the misconception of the chosen option. For a wrong numeric_entry, the misconception of the matched common_error if one matches. Null when correct or unmatched. This is what powers per-misconception diagnosis.

resurfaced.description: True if this item was scheduled by spaced repetition rather than freshly served.

allOf.description: single_best: when not skipped, selected_option must be present and entered_value must be absent.
numeric_entry: when not skipped, entered_value must be present and selected_option must be absent.
When skipped is true, answer fields must be absent.

selected_option.description: single_best: the option key chosen. Must be absent when skipped is true.

entered_value.description: numeric_entry: the value entered. Must be absent when skipped is true.

device_context.description: Optional. Records form factor and viewport width so calibration can separate hard questions from small screens. No personal identifiers.
